DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 花壇の前で、何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something by the flower bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 傾いた苗を植え直したくなりました。持ってきたスコップで直してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参の道具で傾いた苗を直してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to replant the seedling that's leaning over. May I fix it with the trowel I brought?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may straighten the leaning seedling using the tool you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理中の花壇なので、そのままにして職員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This flower bed is under our care, so please leave it as it is and inform a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。少し土を足すだけと思いましたが、植え方の計画があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触で植栽計画を考えていなかったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't touched it yet. I thought it would only need a little more soil, but there is a planting plan, isn't there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not touched it and had not considered the planting plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態はこちらで確認します。花壇のお手入れにご興味があるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check its condition. Are you interested in helping care for the flower bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。家で花を育てています。ここでも手伝えるなら、参加する方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家庭の園芸経験があり活動参加方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I grow flowers at home. If I can help here too, I'd like to know how to join.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention your gardening experience at home and ask how to join the activities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 募集や活動日があるか、管理担当にお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask the person in charge of maintenance whether they are recruiting volunteers or have activity days.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は道具をしまいます。募集がなくても、勝手に作業する理由にはならないと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は道具をしまい無断作業をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put my tools away today. I understand that even if no volunteers are being recruited, that doesn't give me a reason to work without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put your tools away today and will not work without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へは、ご経験と参加したい内容をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell the person in charge about your experience and what you would like to participate in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 苗の手入れを手伝いたいと伝えます。今気づいた傾きは場所を示して報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加希望と傾いた苗の場所の報告を分けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say that I'd like to help care for the seedlings. I'll report the leaning seedling I just noticed by pointing out its location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep your request to participate separate from your report of the leaning seedling's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所を教えてくださりありがとうございます。それでは、担当の案内をご確認ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for showing us the location. Please check the information from the person in charge. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物本体ではなく、部品をお探しなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking for a part, rather than the luggage itself, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。かばんの車輪が一つなくなりました。荷物は手元にありますが、車内で外れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かばんはあるが車輪一つが車内で外れた可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. One wheel has come off my bag. I have the bag with me, but the wheel may have come off on the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have your bag, but one wheel may have come off on the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの列車の、どの辺りに置いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which train was it, and whereabouts did you put it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今降りた列車のドア近くです。乗る前は四つあり、降りて歩いたら傾いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 降りた列車のドア付近と乗降時の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Near the door of the train I just got off. It had four wheels before I boarded, and it was leaning when I walked after getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the area near the door of the train you left and the bag's condition before boarding and after getting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 色や形、大きさが分かる写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a photo showing its color, shape, and size?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 残っている車輪を撮れます。黒い丸形で、手のひらより小さいです。本体の色だけでは探せませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残る黒い小さな車輪を写真で示せると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can photograph one of the remaining wheels. It's black and round, smaller than my palm. The color of the bag alone won't help you find it, will it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you can show a photo of a remaining small black wheel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 部品の特徴も含めて確認します。線路や車両の下へ、ご自身で探しに行かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check, including the part's features. Please don't go onto the tracks or under the train to search yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。転がっていそうでも降りません。今は引かずに持ち上げて、脇で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 線路へ探しに行かず持ち上げて安全な場所で待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't climb down even if it seems to have rolled there. I'll carry the bag instead of pulling it for now and wait to the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not search on the tracks, but will lift the bag and wait somewhere safe. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかるまで、お荷物を運ぶ方法でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Until it is found, are you having trouble carrying your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅の外までは友達に手伝ってもらいます。見つかるかと、今運べるかは別に考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友達に運搬を頼み発見の確認とは分けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask a friend to help me as far as outside the station. I'll treat whether it can be found and whether I can carry the bag now as separate issues.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask a friend to help carry it and keep that separate from checking whether the part has been found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お探しの部品を確認します。それでは、安全な場所でお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check for the part you're looking for. Please wait somewhere safe. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明会の案内について、どの点をご確認になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about the information session notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事で参加できません。隣の人に私の質問を渡せば、私も出席したことになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣人に質問を預けると本人出席扱いになるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't attend because of work. If I give my questions to my neighbor, will I count as having attended too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether entrusting your questions to your neighbor means you yourself count as present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出席の扱いと、質問を伝える方法は別に担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check attendance status and ways of submitting questions separately with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。欠席なのに出席と伝えるつもりはありません。道路の工事予定について聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 欠席と明示し道路工事予定を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I don't intend to say I attended when I was absent. I'd like to ask about the planned roadworks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you will be absent and say you want to know the roadworks schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 質問受付の方法や資料の確認先も、お尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also ask how questions are accepted and where to find the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 口頭で代わりに聞いてもらうより、聞きたい場所を図に書いて提出したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図を付けた質問提出方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than having someone ask verbally on my behalf, I'd like to submit a diagram showing the place I want to ask about.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to submit a question with a diagram. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出先が決まったら、場所とご質問を分かる形にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once you know where to submit it, make the location and your question clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家の前の道全体ではなく、この交差点の通行についてです。自分の名前と返答先も書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象交差点と氏名および返答先を記すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's about passage through this intersection, rather than the whole road in front of my house. I'll also write my name and where to send the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will include the intersection concerned, your name, and your reply contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 隣の方が資料を受け取る場合の扱いも、担当へお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check with the person in charge about the arrangements if your neighbor collects the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 質問の提出と資料の入手を分けて確認します。隣人には、引き受けられるか先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 質問提出と資料入手を分け隣人の意思も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check submitting questions and obtaining materials separately. I'll first ask my neighbor whether they can take this on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check question submission and obtaining materials separately, and also confirm your neighbor's willingness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当の連絡先をご案内します。それでは、そちらへお問い合わせください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the contact details for the person in charge. Please contact them. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票を書き終えた後で、気づいた点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you noticed something since finishing the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「いつから」の欄に今日の日付を書きました。書いた日を聞かれていると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記入日を症状開始欄に書いた誤りを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote today's date in the 'Since when?' box. I thought it was asking for the date I filled it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistakenly wrote the completion date in the symptom onset box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状に気づいた時期の欄ですね。実際に気づいたのはいつ頃ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the box for when you noticed the symptoms. Around when did you actually notice them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の休みの日です。日付を今は覚えていません。今日始まったことにはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先週の休日に始まったが正確な日付は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: On my day off last week. I can't remember the date right now. I don't want it to say they started today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that they started on your day off last week, but you don't know the exact date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かる範囲の時期をお伝えください。訂正する書き方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us the timeframe as far as you know. I'll explain how to make the correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「先週の休みの日から」と直せますか。はっきりしない日付を選んで埋めないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不確かな日付を作らず分かる時期で訂正したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I correct it to 'Since my day off last week'? I want to avoid choosing an uncertain date just to fill the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to correct it using the timeframe you know, without inventing an uncertain date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その時期を担当にもお伝えください。始めの状態と今の状態に違いはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the clinician that timeframe too. Is there any difference between how it was at first and how it is now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 始めは時々気になり、今は長く気になります。日にちだけでなく、その変化も話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 初めは時々で今は長く気になる変化を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: At first it bothered me occasionally, but now it bothers me for longer periods. I'll explain that change as well as the date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the change from occasional discomfort at first to longer periods now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診察で分かる範囲をお伝えください。こちらでは状態の判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: At your consultation, explain as much as you know. We can't assess your condition here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 開始時期の欄を案内どおりに直します。記入日は別の欄で、求められたら今日の日付を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開始時期と求められる記入日を分けて書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll correct the onset box as instructed. If a completion date is requested in a separate box, I'll write today's date there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write the onset timeframe separately from the completion date, if that date is requested. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正箇所も担当へお伝えします。それでは、診察の案内をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll also tell the clinician about the correction. Please wait for instructions for your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵のお問い合わせでしょうか。こちらでご用件を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this an inquiry about keys? I'll listen to the details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の鍵を落としました。持ち主と分かるよう、自宅の住所をここで大きな声で言えばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人確認のため住所を大声で言うべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost my house key. Should I say my home address out loud here so you can tell I'm the owner?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should state your address loudly for identity verification. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周囲に聞こえるように言う必要はありません。確認が必要な情報は担当が伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't need to say it so people around you can hear. The person in charge will ask for any information needed for verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。まず、青い輪と小さな布の飾りが付いている特徴を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青い輪と布飾りの鍵の特徴を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. First, I'll describe it: it has a blue ring and a small fabric ornament.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the key's blue ring and fabric ornament. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: なくした場所や時刻の見当もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have an idea where or when you lost it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方、買い物から戻る間だと思います。玄関でないと気づき、途中のどこかは特定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日夕方の帰り道で具体的な紛失場所は不明と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think it was yesterday evening on my way back from shopping. I noticed it was missing at my front door, and I can't identify where along the way I lost it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it was on your way home yesterday evening, but you don't know the exact place you lost it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 届出の確認と、必要な手続きをご案内します。ほかにも鍵は付いていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain how to check reports and what procedures are needed. Were there any other keys attached?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自転車の鍵も同じ輪に付いていました。住所を書いた札は付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ輪の自転車鍵と住所札がないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My bicycle key was on the same ring. There wasn't a tag with my address on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your bicycle key was on the same ring and there was no address tag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 詳細は担当と確認してください。ご自宅へ戻る際の手配はできていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm the details with the person in charge. Have you arranged how you will get back into your home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同居人に連絡して待ち合わせました。鍵の照会を済ませてから帰り、住所は必要な相手へだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同居人との待合せを済ませ必要な相手だけに住所を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I contacted my housemate and arranged to meet. I'll go home after finishing the key inquiry, and I'll only give my address to those who need it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have arranged to meet your housemate and will give your address only to the necessary people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、確認をお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hand this over to the person in charge. Please wait while they check. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 封筒の中身について確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please let me check what's inside the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族に鍵を一本返したいです。紙と同じように、この薄い封筒へ入れて送りたいのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵一本を薄い封筒で送れるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to return one key to a family member. I was hoping to send it in this thin envelope, just like paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can send one key in a thin envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍵が中で動いたり、封筒を突き破ったりしないよう、包装を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the packaging so that the key doesn't move around inside or pierce the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端が尖っていて、もう紙に跡が付いています。切手を貼る前に持ってきてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 尖った部分が紙に跡を付けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Its edge is pointed, and it has already left a mark on the paper. I'm glad I brought it before putting a stamp on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the pointed part has left a mark on the paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身に合う包装と送り方をご案内します。鍵以外にも入れる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll explain suitable packaging and mailing options for the contents. Will you put anything in besides the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 短い手紙も入れます。鍵は紙に書いた住所と一緒に見える状態にしないよう、別に包みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手紙も入れるが鍵と住所の紙を分けて包みたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll include a short letter too. I'd like to wrap the key separately so it isn't visible together with the address written on the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will also include a letter, but want to wrap the key separately from the paper bearing the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装後の厚さや重さ、取扱条件を確認します。今はまだ封をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the thickness, weight, and handling conditions after packaging. Please don't seal it yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。中で動かないようにする方法を聞きます。家族にも発送前だと伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包装方法を聞き家族へまだ発送前と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I'll ask how to keep it from moving inside. I'll also tell my family I haven't sent it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about packaging and tell your family it has not yet been sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備が整ったら、利用できる方法と料金を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: When it's ready, let's check the available methods and prices.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒の見た目だけで手紙と同じと思わず、中身が鍵だと伝えてから送り方を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見た目で分類せず鍵が入ることを伝え送り方を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't assume it's the same as a letter just from the envelope's appearance. I'll say there's a key inside before choosing how to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not classify it by appearance, but will explain it contains a key and choose a mailing method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 包装の案内をいたします。それでは、こちらで一緒に確認しましょう。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll explain the packaging. Let's check it together here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご記入の金額について、確認したいことがあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about the amount you entered, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三万円のつもりで三十万円と書いてしまいました。ゼロを消しましたが、直した箇所が読みにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三万円を三十万円と書き消した箇所が読みにくいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I meant 30,000 yen, but wrote 300,000 yen. I erased a zero, but the corrected area is hard to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote 300,000 yen instead of 30,000 yen and the erased area is hard to read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま提出せず、訂正方法を確認しましょう。ご希望は三万円でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check how to correct it before you submit it as it is. The amount you want is 30,000 yen, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、三万円です。見た目を整えるために上からなぞるより、書き直したほうがよいか伺いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望額を確認し書直しの要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, 30,000 yen. I'd like to ask whether I should fill it out again, instead of tracing over it to make it look neater.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your intended amount and ask whether you need to fill out a new form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が用紙の扱いをご案内します。金額以外の欄も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain how to handle the form. Please check the fields other than the amount too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 日付と名前は合っています。金額だけ間違えたので、そこを知らせず渡すのは避けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日付と名前は正しく金額の誤りを申告すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The date and name are correct. Only the amount is wrong, so I'll avoid handing it over without telling them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the date and name are correct and you will report the error in the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい用紙をご案内する場合も、前の用紙と混ざらないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If we give you a new form, please keep it from getting mixed up with the old one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い用紙をどこへ渡すかも聞きます。二枚とも有効なつもりで持たないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い用紙の扱いを聞き二枚を混在させないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask where to hand in the old form too. I'll make sure I don't keep both as though they were both valid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask how to handle the old form and keep the two forms from being mixed up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手続き前に、ご希望の金額をもう一度お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before the procedure, please check the amount you want once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三万円と声に出して確認します。ゼロの数を数えてから、担当の案内どおり提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三万円と読みゼロの数も確かめて提出すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say '30,000 yen' aloud to check. I'll count the zeros, then submit it as the person in charge instructs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will read it as 30,000 yen, check the number of zeros, and submit it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 金額のご確認ありがとうございます。それでは、担当が用紙をご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for confirming the amount. The person in charge will now guide you about the form. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札と商品の組合せをご確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking which price tag goes with which product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このジャムは三百円だと思いました。レジへ行く前に見ると、隣の小さい瓶の値札かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三百円の値札が隣の小瓶用か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought this jam was 300 yen. When I looked before going to the checkout, I realized that might be the tag for the smaller jar beside it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the 300-yen price tag is for the small jar beside it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品名と容量を照らし合わせます。お持ちの瓶は四百五十円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll compare the product name and volume. The jar you're holding is 450 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらは四百五十円ですね。三つで九百円と思っていたので、予算を超えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一瓶四百五十円では三つが予算超過と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one is 450 yen, then. I thought three would cost 900 yen, so that puts me over budget.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that at 450 yen per jar, three will exceed your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ物を三つなら、千三百五十円になります。数量を変更されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Three of the same would be 1,350 yen. Would you like to change the quantity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は二つにして九百円にします。別の商品を安いと思い込んで混ぜず、この瓶二つを選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つ九百円に数量を変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll get two for 900 yen today. I won't mix in a different product assuming it's cheaper; I'll choose two of this jar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Change the quantity to two for 900 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。棚へ戻す一本はお預かりしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. Shall I take the one jar you're returning to the shelf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。どの値札に対応する場所か、置き間違えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 戻す一本を店員に渡し位置の取り違えを避けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I want to avoid putting it in the wrong spot by mistaking which price tag it belongs to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will give the staff member the jar to return and avoid confusing its shelf position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻す位置はこちらで確認します。ほかに価格をご確認になる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check where to return it. Is there anything else whose price you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はありません。二つで九百円という計算と、会計の表示を最後に照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの計算と会計表示を照合すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Nothing for now. At the end, I'll compare my calculation of 900 yen for two with the checkout display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will compare your calculation for two jars with the checkout display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お会計でもご確認ください。それでは、レジへお進みください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please check at the checkout too. Please proceed to the register. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチのところで、何か気になる物がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice something by the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折れた傘が置いてあります。ごみだと思って捨てようとしましたが、持ち主が戻るかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 壊れた傘を捨てる前に持主が戻る可能性を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a broken umbrella there. I was about to throw it away as rubbish, but its owner might come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before throwing away the broken umbrella, ask about the possibility that its owner might return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所と状態を教えてください。今、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where it is and its condition. Are you holding it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、そのままです。入口から二つ目のベンチで、先の骨が一本飛び出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未移動の場所と一本飛び出す骨を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I've left it where it was. It's at the second bench from the entrance, and one rib is sticking out at the tip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe its location, say you have not moved it, and explain that one rib is sticking out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 管理担当が確認します。骨に触れず、ほかの利用者にも近づきすぎないようお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The maintenance team will check. Don't touch the rib, and please let other users know not to get too close.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一緒に来た子どもには触らないよう話しました。ベンチを使いたい人へは、端に傘があると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもに触らせずベンチ利用者にも位置を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've told the child who came with me not to touch it. I'll tell anyone wanting to use the bench that the umbrella is at the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the child from touching it and tell bench users where it is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち主かどうか、ご存じの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know anyone who might know whether it belongs to someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 誰の物かは分かりません。壊れているだけで、捨てた物だとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所有者不明で破損だけでは廃棄物と断定できないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't know whose it is. Just because it's broken doesn't mean we can say it was thrown away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the owner is unknown and damage alone does not prove it is rubbish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態で担当へ引き継ぎます。ご自身で傘を開いて確かめる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on its condition to the person in charge. There's no need to open the umbrella yourself to check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 開かずに場所を案内します。傘を動かす判断は任せて、私たちは別のベンチを使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開かず案内し管理者に任せ別のベンチを使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show you where it is without opening it. I'll leave the decision to move it to you, and we'll use another bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the location without opening it, leave it to the manager, and use another bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。それでは、こちらで状態を確認いたします。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. We'll check its condition. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待ち合わせの場所を確認したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to check your meeting place, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達に「降りた所で待って」と言われました。切符を持っていない友達も、ホームまで来られると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 切符のない友人も到着ホームへ来られると思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend told me, 'Wait where you get off.' I thought my friend could come to the platform even without a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought your friend without a ticket could come to your arrival platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札内へ入る条件は別に確認が必要です。改札の外で待ち合わせるのはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The conditions for entering through the ticket gates need to be checked separately. How about meeting outside the gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そのほうが分かりやすそうです。ホーム番号を伝えず、出口の名前を友達へ送りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ホーム番号でなく出口名を伝えて待合せたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: That sounds easier to understand. I'd like to send my friend the exit name instead of the platform number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to arrange your meeting using the exit name rather than the platform number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どちらの出口が都合よいか、相手の現在地をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check where the other person is now to see which exit would be convenient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友達はバスで来ます。私はまだ出口を決めず、バスを降りた場所を聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: バスで来る友人の降車場所を先に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend is coming by bus. I won't choose an exit yet; I'll ask where they're getting off the bus first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will first ask where your friend coming by bus will get off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出口の表示を確認し、双方が同じ場所を指しているかお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check the exit signs and make sure you are both referring to the same place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。「駅の前」だけでは違う場所になりそうなので、表示にある出口名で聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 曖昧な駅前でなく表示の出口名で聞き直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Just saying 'in front of the station' might mean different places, so I'll ask again using the exit name on the sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask again using the exit name on the sign instead of the vague phrase 'in front of the station.' Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会えるまで、通行の妨げにならない場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait somewhere you won't obstruct others until you meet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 改札の外へ出てから連絡します。相手の返事を見て、出口名を一致させて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 改札外で返事を見て出口名を一致させると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll contact them after going outside the ticket gates. I'll read their reply, make sure our exit names match, and wait there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the reply outside the gates and make sure the exit names match. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 出口の案内図はこちらです。それでは、よいお待ち合わせになりますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-20213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's the exit map. I hope you find each other easily. Goodbye.
